test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

ZMA, EHF, JCK, OXP, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

** The alphabets at odd places are increased to 5 positional values.**

 The alphabets at even places are decreased to 5 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf2de8db6efec9e960b36bcf5aa5bbaa4d1f825c03984f96c6ac74e486056b1.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
